Many law firms rely heavily on paid advertising to generate leads, but understanding the difference between lawyer SEO and Google Ads is critical for long-term success. The most effective strategy is not choosing one over the other, but using them strategically—starting with a solid SEO foundation and then scaling with ads when needed.
